info.title: Dregs API
info.description:
Customer REST API for sending events and reading fraud scores, identities, devices, escalations, channels, datasets, and mappings.

Authenticate with a secret key created in the dashboard under Settings > Credentials (security scheme secretKey). Send it as a Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer sk_... The key acts as an admin of that credential's team. POST /api/events and GET /api/devices/{fingerprint} also accept the credential's public key (security scheme publicKey, Bearer pk_...). Public keys may be embedded in a browser. Secret keys must not.

This document is the curated public surface. Dashboard sign-in, billing, team administration, and trainer tools are not included.

delete.description: Delete a mapping. Requires the admin role. Deleting a customer mapping makes that source fall back to the global default.

id.description: Optional client-supplied event ID for idempotent ingestion. When provided, repeated posts with the same ID are silently deduplicated against the previous event for the customer. Must not start with "dregs-" and must be at most 64 characters. When omitted, the server generates a dregs-{UUID} identifier.

secretKey.description: Customer secret key from Settings > Credentials, sent as a Bearer token. The token value starts with sk_. It acts as an admin of that credential's team for every operation in this document. MCP tokens (dmcp_) are refused. Prefer the publicKey scheme on operations that accept a pk_ key.

publicKey.description: Customer public key from Settings > Credentials, sent as a Bearer token. The token value starts with pk_. Accepted only by POST /api/events and GET /api/devices/{fingerprint}. It may be embedded in a browser. It cannot call the other operations in this document.
